mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers policy response and risk aversion, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in UNRATE > 9.0% periods over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand weakness that triggers flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between RSAFS and HOUST yields Rank IC above -0.03 over any 3-year window or 60-day returns are not significantly negative in simultaneous decline periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During sustained industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0 for 3 consecutive months), recessionary fears drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in INDPRO < 95.0 periods over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that prompts monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained payroll decline (PAYEMS < 0.5% monthly growth for 3 months), weakening labor market reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in PAYEMS < 0.5% periods over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST as predictor of 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window or average 20-day returns in rising HOUST periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates severe supply-side shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term between INDPRO and GDPC1 yields Rank IC above -0.03 over any 3-year window or 5-day returns are not significantly negative in simultaneous decline periods (t-test p > 0.05).
